messages:
Ava Patel: Heads-up — we have a request from CloudChannel for a private offer that needs a surge cap and a coordinated joint announcement. Need alignment on pricing, crediting, and timing.
Daniel Kim: TL;DR what they want for surge cap?
Ava Patel: They want 3x baseline usage for first 90 days if they exceed commit, with temporary burst pricing waived for that window. Also want a co-branded launch the week after acceptance.
Priya Nair: Co-marketing OK but we need exact offer language + logos cleared. Can we keep the discount simple? Sales prefer tiered discounts.
Daniel Kim: Proposed commercial: 12mo commit, 22% off list, $150k onboarding credit, surge cap = 3x baseline for 90d, then standard overage pricing.
Priya Nair: Draft message for joint announce: short, data point + quote from partner + link to product page. I'll draft.
Sam O'Connor: Legal flag — auto-renew clauses need explicit opt-out windows. Also require a simple clause for surge abuse (sustained >3x for 180d triggers renegotiation).
Leo Alvarez: Finance note — onboarding credit flows against first invoice; need to cap total credits per customer. Also need MRR projection impact for reserves.
Ava Patel: Ok action items: @Priya to draft joint announce, @Sam to add legal language, @Leo to validate credit cap, @Daniel to confirm commercial terms with partner. Target: finalize by EOD Friday.
Priya Nair: Working on announce draft now. Quick Q: want the partner to preview quote before public? or only internal preview?
Daniel Kim: We should offer a partner preview two business days prior to public announce. Good for quote + logo checks.
Priya Nair: Noted. I'll include a 48h partner preview in the draft.
Sam O'Connor: Draft legal snippet (copy/paste):
```
Partner Preview: Partner will be provided a draft announcement 48 hours prior to publication for review solely to confirm factual accuracy and trademark usage.
Surge Abuse: If monthly usage > 3x committed baseline for more than 180 consecutive days, Redwood reserves the right to pause surge benefits pending commercial review.
Auto-Renew: Offer auto-renews unless written opt-out received at least 60 days before term end.
```
Leo Alvarez: FYI - quick credit table I sketched:
```
Commit band | Onboarding credit cap
--------------------------------
<$500k     | $50k
$500k-1M   | $150k
>1M        | $300k
```
Ava Patel: Nice, Leo. That gives us guardrails. Daniel — confirm partner OK with those caps?
Daniel Kim: Pinged them. They asked if we can make the >1M band $350k instead. I'll push back and say $300k is our upper bound for this wave.
Priya Nair: Draft headline options: 1) "Redwood + CloudChannel simplify enterprise inference economics" 2) "New private offer: flexible surge + onboarding credits" I'll send 1-pager in #marketing-drafts.
announce-bot: Reminder scheduled: marketing review meeting tomorrow 10:00am.
Ava Patel: Final question — rollout sequence: private acceptance -> partner preview (48h) -> joint press + partner email -> Redwood blog + support KB. Any objections?
Sam O'Connor: Legal fine with that sequence. Ensure PR has approval checklist.
Leo Alvarez: Finance OK, confirm billing flows before publish.
Daniel Kim: Partner confirmed verbally, pushing to legal for final sign-off. Will update here when signed.
Priya Nair: Cool, I'll attach the announce copy + one-slide partner blurb after the review.
Ava Patel: Thanks all — will reconvene if any blockers. :thumbsup:
